<b>Void Masses</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are clumps of creatures bound together by [[Void]] soaked threads.<ref>Void Mass [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Dense knot of husks bound tight by void soaked Silk."</i></ref> Their presence in a room can be heard by sounds of howling wind and faint garbled voices.
== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Void Masses are immobile enemies that cling to the ceiling or walls. When approached or attacked, it performs one of two attacks in the direction of the target:

* <b>Void Tendrils:</b> Lashes out with void tendrils. 
* <b>Void Projectiles:</b> Fires three consecutive void projectiles.

Void Masses deal {{Damage|2|type=Void}} on contact, as well as with the Void Projectiles attack; the Void Tendrils attack deals {{Damage|1+1|type=Void}}.

When Hornet enters a room containing a Void Mass, the enemy roster in that location is modified. All enemies in the room not immune to [[Black-Threading|black-threading]] spawn in already black-threaded, with some exceptions. The presence of a Void Mass can also be deduced from the sounds of howling winds in places that would normally lack it.

Void Masses do not respawn when destroyed, except the two near [[Styx]] (which only spawn in <abbr title="The default game mode.">Classic Mode</abbr>), which respawn after exiting and reentering the room if only one is destroyed. There are 47 known Void Masses (45 in [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]]) across the entirety of [[Pharloom]], though Hornet only needs to destroy 12 to complete the <i>[[Dark Hearts]]</i> Wish.

Enemies that spawn as a result of the presence of a Void Mass may differ from ones without it, including some rarer enemies. It may be wiser to leave some alive when attempting to complete the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal.]]

== Location ==
47 Void Masses in total (45 in [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]]) can be found across [[Pharloom]] beginning in [[Acts#Act 3: Abyss|Act 3]].

*1 can be found in [[Bone Bottom]], [[Weavenest Atla]], [[Bilewater]], [[Grand Gate]], and [[Cogwork Core]].
*2 can be found in the [[Hunter's March]] and [[High Halls]].
*3 can be found in the [[Far Fields]], [[Blasted Steps]], [[Underworks]], [[Deep Docks]], [[Sinner's Road]],<ref group="Note">The two near [[Styx]] do not appear in [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]].</ref> and [[Whispering Vaults]].
*4 can be found in [[the Marrow]].
*5 can be found in [[Greymoor]] and [[Shellwood]].
*6 can be found in the [[Choral Chambers]].

== Trivia ==
* Void Masses do not respond to the [[Needolin]], as is the case for most Void-derived enemies.
** Along with not responding to the [[Needolin]], the Void Mass does not grant [[Silk]] when attacked by the [[Needle]].
* The appearance of the Void Mass is based off the creatures in whatever part of the environment it is in; the Hunter's Journal entry icon is of one in the [[Choral Chambers]], as a [[Choristor]], [[Reed]], and [[Choir Bellbearer]] can be seen tangled up in the black threads.
** One in [[Bilewater]] is [[Stilkin Trapper|Stilkin Trappers]].
** Ones across [[Blasted Steps]] are a [[Pilgrim Pouncer]], [[Pilgrim Groveller]], and [[Pilgrim Hulk]]. One in the [[Great Conchflies]] arena is a [[Driznit]] and [[Driznarga]].
** One in [[Bone Bottom]] is a [[Pilgrim Pouncer]], [[Pilgrim Groveller]], and [[Pilgrim Hulk]].
** Ones across [[Choral Chambers]] are a [[Choristor]], [[Reed]], and [[Choir Bellbearer]].
** One in [[Cogwork Core]] is [[Cogwork Choirbug|Cogwork Choirbugs]].
** Ones across [[Deep Docks]] are a [[Smelt Shoveller]] and [[Flintflame Flyer]]. One in upper Deep Docks is a [[Skull Scuttler]], [[Skull Brute]], and [[Beastfly]]. 
** Ones across [[Far Fields]] and one in [[Hunter's March]] are a [[Skarr Scout]] and [[Skarr Stalker]].
** One in [[Grand Gate]] near [[Shrine Guardian Seth|Seth's]] arena is [[Phacia|Phacias]].
** Ones in [[Greymoor]] near [[Greymoor#Sub-Area: Craw Lake|Craw Lake]] are a [[Craw]] and [[Tallcraw]]. Ones near the towers are a [[Silk Snipper]] and [[Dreg Catcher]]. One in the tunnels near the Bellway is of a [[Mite]] and [[Fluttermite]]. One in the middle of Greymoor is a [[Winged Pilgrim]], [[Pilgrim Groveller]], and [[Pilgrim Hulk]].
** One in [[High Halls]] is a [[Choristor]], [[Reed]], and [[Choir Bellbearer]], despite these enemies not appearing in this area. Another is of [[Minister|Ministers]].
** Ones across [[Shellwood]] are of [[Splinter|Splinters]], and ones of [[Splinterbark|Splinterbarks]]. One in western Shellwood is of [[Pondcatcher|Pondcatchers]].
** One in lower [[Sinner's Road]] are of [[Roachcatcher]]s and [[Roachfeeder]]s. In [[Styx|Styx's]] nest are of [[Silkeater]] cocoons.
** One in [[the Marrow]] is of a [[Winged Pilgrim]], [[Pilgrim Groveller]], and [[Pilgrim Hulk]]. One near the Deep Docks entrance is of a [[Smelt Shoveller]], [[Flintflame Flyer]], and [[Skull Brute]].
** Ones across [[Underworks]] are of an [[Underworker]], [[Underpoke]], [[Underloft]], and [[Underscrub]].
** One in [[Weavenest Atla]] is of [[Mossmir|Mossmirs]].
** Ones across [[Whispering Vaults]] are of a [[Scrollreader]], [[Lampbearer]], and [[Vaultborn]].
* The Void Mass is one of the few enemies that never respawns, and defeating all of them gives no additional reward.
